summary: This proposed standard defines an SMTP extension where the client declares the estimated size of a message so the server can decline it, perhaps temporarily, before it is sent. It was replaced by RFC 1653.

eli5.summary: Before sending a big package, you tell the receiver how big it is so they can say no if there is no room. This extension lets email servers do that.

questions: what is the smtp size extension
how does smtp announce message size
